title: Udrive - Car Sharing & Rental
summary: Affordable, pay-per-minute to monthly car rental app. Self-drive across UAE
description:
Udrive: Flexible Car Sharing & Pay-Per-Minute Car Rentals Across the UAE

Udrive makes driving easy, affordable, and hassle-free. Access hundreds of cars available on-demand across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and major cities in the UAE. Choose flexible self-drive options—whether you need a car for minutes, hours, days, or even months.

Forget traditional car rental hassles—no paperwork, no waiting lines, just seamless car hire directly from your smartphone!

Why Choose Udrive?
* Pay-Per-Minute Pricing: Only pay for the exact time you use.
* Instant Access: Hundreds of cars available around the clock, conveniently located near you.
* Fully Inclusive: Pricing includes fuel, parking, and insurance—no hidden charges.
* Flexible Rentals: Choose from minute-by-minute, daily, weekly, or monthly rental plans tailored to your needs.

Easy Self-Drive: Unlock, start, and return cars effortlessly through our intuitive app.

How It Works:
1. Find & Book: Open the app to locate available cars nearby.
2. Unlock & Drive with a single tap
3. Park & End Trip - End your rental effortlessly through the app.

Enjoy the ultimate convenience of on-demand mobility with Udrive.
